title: 2D Heat Equation Simulation Using Parallel Computing
description: Implemented a 2D heat equation solver in C++ using MPI for distributed memory parallelism and NVIDIA’s CUDA for GPU acceleration, benchmarking strong and weak scaling across more parallelized systems.

Achieved an 864x speedup over serial by deploying 12 GPUs on the AiMOS supercomputer, applying row-wise domain decomposition, “halo” region exchange via MPI p2p communication, and shared memory to optimize GPU memory access.

title: Distributed Key-Value Store Implementation
description: Designed, implemented, and stress tested a fault-tolerant network system in Java through replicated servers supporting causal consistency, consensus based replication (Paxos), and Byzantine fault-tolerance.

title: IBM Widget for Interactive Quantum Art
description: Built a widget to simulate fractal art based on qubits using IBM’s Qiskit in Python in order to introduce children and the public into the field of Quantum Computing.

title: RCOS Thrifty
description: Developed a full stack p2p marketplace for RPI students, enabling buying and selling old or used items.
Used React.js frontend and Firebase for authentication and backend for real time listings & communication.

title: RCOS CRISIS
description: Team member developing a more accessible website, CRISIS, with a more modern and easily usable interface for RPI’s course and degree information.
